fusions.name: Mildew Puff
fusions.desc: Puffs a cone of spores ahead of you, dealing 3 poison damage to everything in it with a 30% chance to leave each [Diseased] for 6 seconds. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Harvest the Rot
fusions.desc: Bites an enemy at or below 30% health, dealing 18 poison damage, and consumes every affliction on it, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit. You heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Hushing Spores
fusions.desc: Veils you and your allies for 8 seconds: enemies notice you 50% later, you move 10% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack. You regain 10 health.

fusions.name: Decay Dividend
fusions.desc: When one of your afflictions runs its course, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
